d: Responsible for managing AUBH’s social media accounts and creating engaging content that showcases the university, student life, academic programs, and campus activities. The role involves content planning, photography, video production, and keeping up with social media trends to strengthen the university’s online presence.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Public Relations, or related field.
Professional certification in a related field is desirable.
Fresh Graduates are encouraged to apply.
Strong photography skills are a must.
Ability to shoot and edit short-form videos using tools such as CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro.
Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and current social media trends.
Creative, proactive, and organized, with strong communication skills.
A portfolio showcasing photography, video editing, or social media content is an advantage.
Excellent writing and editing skills in Arabic and English.
Ability to analyze and interpret data.
r: Manage AUBH’s social media accounts and develop a monthly content calendar.
Generate creative content ideas for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Stories, and other platforms.
Capture high-quality photographs and videos of students, campus life, and university events.
Edit short-form videos and produce engaging social media content.
Create and publish Instagram Stories and provide live coverage of events and activities.
Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to increase engagement.
Coordinate with the Marketing team to align content with campaigns and university priorities.

d: Our client, a leading manufacturing organization in the region, is seeking an accomplished Vice President – People to provide strategic leadership across the full spectrum of Human Capital, Administration, and Corporate Services. Reporting to the executive leadership team, this role will shape the organization's people strategy, drive organizational transformation, and ensure the delivery of world-class HR and shared services that support long-term business growth.

This is a highly visible executive leadership role responsible for aligning people strategy with business objectives, leading organizational development, driving Emiratization, and overseeing employee services, facilities, and administration across a large, complex industrial environment.
q: Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
Professional HR certifications such as CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent are highly preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience, including significant executive-level responsibility.
Proven leadership experience within manufacturing, industrial, engineering, heavy industry, or similarly complex operational environments.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide Human Capital transformation initiatives.
Extensive experience across talent acquisition, organizational development, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, learning and development, and administration.
Proven experience leading Emiratization strategies and workforce nationalization initiatives.
Strong commercial acumen with responsibility for large operational budgets and vendor management.
Experience managing shared services including facilities, administration, and employee support functions is highly desirable.
Organizational transformation and change management expertise.
Deep understanding of local Labour Law and the Emiratization landscape.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Data-driven decision making and workforce analytics capability.
Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
High levels of integrity, professionalism, and discretion.
Ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced industrial environment.
Fluency in English is essential. Arabic is highly preferred.
Employee satisfaction across People and Corporate Services.
Talent attraction, retention, and succession readiness.
Accuracy and effective utilization of divisional budgets.
Service quality and operational efficiency across corporate services.
Compliance with HR policies, governance, and legislative requirements.
Vendor performance, service quality, and cost optimization.
Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental compliance.
This is a fully onsite executive leadership position based at the client's Head Office in Mussafah, Abu Dhabi.
r: Serve as a member of the Executive Management team, contributing to the development and execution of corporate strategy and long-term business objectives.
Develop and implement the annual operating plan and strategic roadmap for the People and Corporate Services function.
Lead enterprise-wide organizational transformation and change management initiatives that improve business performance and organizational effectiveness.
Define and execute the overall Human Capital strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and future workforce requirements.
Establish an effective organizational structure that supports operational excellence, scalability, and business growth.
Lead annual workforce planning and budgeting, ensuring effective resource allocation and cost optimization.
Oversee divisional budgets, financial performance, and productivity while ensuring efficient utilization of resources.
Develop and implement people strategies that attract, develop, engage, and retain high-performing talent.
Lead workforce planning, talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, learning and development, and organizational capability initiatives.
Drive company-wide performance management frameworks aligned with business objectives.
Oversee compensation, benefits, rewards, recognition, and employee wellbeing strategies to ensure competitiveness and regulatory compliance.
Champion employee engagement, culture transformation, diversity, inclusion, and employer branding initiatives.
Develop and oversee grievance management, employee relations, and conflict resolution frameworks.
Ensure HR policies, governance, and employment practices remain compliant with local Labour Law and applicable regulations.
Lead the company's Emiratization strategy, ensuring achievement of government targets while building sustainable talent pipelines.
Provide executive oversight of corporate administration and employee services.

Lead Facilities and Services operations, including accommodation, transportation, catering, reception, security, mail services, clinic operations, maintenance, landscaping, cleaning, and other employee support services.
Ensure service excellence through effective vendor management, service level agreements, and continuous performance improvement.
Identify outsourcing opportunities and manage strategic partnerships to improve efficiency while maintaining service quality and cost effectiveness.
Drive the adoption of technology and digital HR solutions to improve operational efficiency and employee experience.
Evaluate HR systems, analytics platforms, and automation opportunities to enhance decision making and workforce insights.
Develop meaningful people analytics and executive dashboards to support strategic workforce planning.
Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team across Human Capital and Corporate Services.
Establish clear KPIs and accountability frameworks for departmental leaders.
Represent the People function at Executive Committee meetings and provide strategic advice to senior leadership.
Foster collaboration across business functions while driving a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with EHS legislation and organizational policies.
Ensure all People and Corporate Services activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, governance, and internal audit requirements.
Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities, government entities, and external stakeholders.
